title: The Storm Channel
logline: A cartographer charts an un-taxed jump channel through regional ion storms, threatening the toll monopoly of an interstellar transit cartel that will kill to keep the passage secret.

roles.description: A veteran astrophysicist who has mapped deep solar anomalies across three sectors; stubborn, idealistic, refusing to sell to gate trusts.
Represents isolated agricultural colonies crushed by forty-percent gate tariffs; pragmatic, desperate for affordable logistics.
A heavy armored patrol cruiser dispatched to interdict off-grid jump traffic in the frontier systems.
The interstellar corporation holding the licensed gate franchise and transit monopoly across the cluster.
The loose league of frontier worlds seeking economic survival free of commercial gate subjugation.
A deep-space listening outpost mounted at the threshold of the regional ion storm front.
An unmanned communications buoy anchored in a neighboring star system.
The orbital cargo dock of a frontier agricultural world two jumps from the core.

public_situation: Prohibitive jump gate tariffs imposed by {role:transit_cartel} threaten to starve frontier systems, leaving food freighters grounded.
private_truth: {role:frontier_cartographer} discovered that seasonal fluctuations in the regional ion storm create a safe, un-taxed jump corridor bypassing the cartel's gates completely.

beats.public_change: {role:frontier_cartographer} transmits a coded plea to colonial leaders from {role:storm_observatory} before her primary antenna is jammed.

missions.reason: She needs an outside pilot to extract the master telemetry drive before cartel security raids the outpost under the guise of an equipment audit.
missions.private_fact: Her research was funded years ago by the cartel before she realized they intended to bury the bypass forever.

beats.public_change: Unidentified patrol ships begin scanning perimeter buoys in the neighboring sector, searching for navigational drift nodes.

missions.reason: She needs the pilot to jump to the adjacent system and calibrate the border relay to ensure the ion drift corridor remains stable for heavy freight hulls.
missions.private_fact: She knows that two previous scout crews disappeared in the storm because they jumped five minutes outside the harmonic alignment window.

beats.public_change: Cartel scout interceptors drop into the relay zone, transmitting kill orders against all unchartered vessels.

missions.reason: The delegate needs the cartel hunter pack destroyed before they can triangulate the relay position and scuttle the corridor entry beacons.
missions.private_fact: The delegate is carrying forged transport permits to evacuate his family if the new navigation route fails.

beats.public_change: The colonial alliance stages a prototype grain hauler on the system rim, waiting for storm-shielded guidance equipment.

missions.reason: He needs heavy atmospheric sensor shielding purchased from industrial hubs and brought to the terminus to protect the lead cargo vessel's navigation array.
missions.private_fact: He mortgaged the colony's entire emergency fuel reserve to purchase the shielding.

beats.public_change: {role:corridor_enforcer} takes position directly across the corridor exit, powering primary particle batteries.

missions.reason: He needs the cartel cruiser broken so the pioneer grain convoy can break out into open space and prove the passage is viable.
missions.private_fact: The cartel captain hails mid-fight offering fifty years of free commercial gate passes and a heavy credit bounty to turn over the navigation drive.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot disables the cartel cruiser and escorts the grain convoy through the ion passage.
resolutions.summary: The pioneer convoy arrives intact. The ion corridor becomes an open bypass route, shattering {role:transit_cartel}'s regional tariff monopoly.

consequences.public_summary: A mercenary broke the gate trust's flagship and guided the first free convoy through the ion storm.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot surrenders the master navigation drive for the cartel's gate pass and credit reward.
resolutions.summary: {role:transit_cartel} assumes exclusive control of the ion corridor. Automated defense batteries seal the route, leaving the frontier colonies economically trapped.

consequences.public_summary: Pilots tell of a smuggler who handed the master ion maps to the gate barons for a lifetime pass.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot abandons the mission or loses critical telemetry during the transit runs.
resolutions.summary: Cartel gunboats destroy the border relay beacons. The ion corridor remains classified as fatal navigational space, and {role:transit_cartel} raises tariffs further.

loose_threads.detail: The navigation recorder on {role:corridor_enforcer} logs twelve successful crossings through the supposedly impassable storm dated last spring.
The debt debenture for {role:border_relay} is owned by an anonymous merchant holding firm that holds sixty percent of the cartel's gate bonds.
The research permit posted at {role:storm_observatory} bears the seal of a university department that was officially shuttered twenty years ago.

radio_hooks: Colonial delegates protest twenty-percent increase in {role:transit_cartel} inter-system gate levies.
{role:transit_cartel} warns unchartered ion storm flights risk total hull ionization and navigation loss.
Grain reserves across outer worlds fall below emergency thresholds as transit gridlocks continue.

voice_direction.frontier_cartographer: Quiet, steely, and fiercely articulate. Speaks with the calm precision of an academic who has stopped caring about personal safety and cares only about the math.
voice_direction.colony_delegate: Raspy, strained, and visibly burdened by responsibility. Talks in urgent bursts, continually checking timestamps and inventory ledgers.
